metadata.title: The Clarity Act Fails. Could It Be Time to Buy Crypto Stocks?<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
The Clarity Act Fails. Could It Be Time to Buy Crypto Stocks?
Bitcoin and other cryptocurrencies fell Wednesday after the Clarity Act, a key crypto regulation bill, failed in the Senate on Tuesday, but Wall Street doesn’t view this as a fatal blow to crypto-related stocks.
